key_findings: TNBS-induced chronic pancreatitis increased VGluT1 and membrane trafficking/phosphorylation of GluR1 and NR2B in the ACC, and ACC NMDAR/AMPAR blockade attenuated abdominal hyperalgesia.
Chemogenetic inhibition of ACC pyramidal neurons reduced pancreatitis-related hyperalgesia and anxiety, while optogenetic activation did not aggravate them.
